pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H, 2 dầm ngang, cao ≈120 m trên mực nước
pylons_en: 2 H-shaped pylons with 2 cross-beams, ≈120 m above water

pylon_custom.description: H pylon: two slender, slightly tapered, near-vertical legs standing just outside the deck edges, straight down to the pile cap (no diamond). One cross-beam under the deck and one upper cross-beam about mid-height above the deck; the stays anchor in the leg tops above the upper beam. Deck has a strong vertical crest curve.

model3d.notes: From Commons side and deck-level photos: H legs, under-deck beam plus one upper beam at ≈55% of the above-deck height; ≈120 m total above high water (deck ≈38 m up, so ≈82 m above deck). 128 stays = 16 per side per plane.

review: H pylon had no cross-beam heights and no below-deck leg
Added legs to the footing, 2 cross-beams (under deck and ≈42 m above deck), anchor zone 48–80 m, vertical deck crest noted
